Name: Sylv's Rug Retexture (AT)
Author: SylverScourge
Description:
[size=3]  I didn't think there was enough mods that drastically changed the modern and funky rugs so I made one myself! Uses alternative textures and I tried to make it pretty vanilla style but I like subdued colours so that may not have worked. 

 [b]Recommend Mods[/b] - I made this mod with my save in mind and these are some of the mods I use!
